title: Nash Pad
description:
Experience convenience at its finest in this centrally located home. Your entire group will have effortless access to various amenities. Nearby, you'll find grocery stores, a selection of local dining establishments, and vibrant bars! Within a short drive, you can explore Opry Mills Mall and reach Nashville Airport. Moreover, the bustling energy of downtown Broadway is a mere 7 miles away, ensuring a memorable and accessible adventure for all!

The space
Beautiful home just minutes from Music Valley Rd and the Grand Ole Opry.  A short drive from the airport and an easy Uber/Lyft to the bright lights and live music of downtown Broadway.

Guest access
You have access to the entire house.

Other things to note
